verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a scriptable Editor API at api.playcanvas.com/editor for programmatic scene manipulation, asset management and custom tooling, which a runtime probe confirms. It also lists REST API access on its plans, and the user manual points to changing scenes from code via the Editor API or from an agent via the official MCP server. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), REST API evidenced only as a plan-tier line item without reference docs, no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the Editor API.
